assessment.title: Assessment
assessment.instructions: Read each question to the candidate. Score 0–5 based on the evidence they describe. Capture observable changes and supporting practices in their own words.
assessment.observableChangesHint: What has changed for the candidate? (concrete, observable)
assessment.practicesHint: What is the candidate doing differently? What supports it?

domainDescriptions.employment: Capacity to access, sustain and progress in paid work.
domainDescriptions.housing: Capacity to secure and maintain stable housing.
domainDescriptions.education: Capacity to acquire and use skills and qualifications.
domainDescriptions.health: Physical and mental health, agency over wellbeing.
domainDescriptions.belonging: Sense of belonging, identity, dignity in community.
domainDescriptions.rights: Knowledge and exercise of rights, citizenship pathway.

measurements.emp_p_lang: How confident are you in describing your work experience in English?
measurements.emp_p_dig: How often do you use the internet for job searching or CV editing?
measurements.emp_p_self: I believe I can handle unexpected challenges in a work setting. (Agree/disagree)
measurements.emp_p_orient: Do you have a specific career goal for the next year?
measurements.emp_p_ready: How ready do you feel to attend a UK job interview tomorrow? (1-10)
measurements.emp_s_peer: How many people do you know who are working in the UK?
measurements.emp_s_mentor: Do you know someone with a similar background who is working successfully in the UK?
measurements.emp_s_trust: I trust my job support agency to act in my best interest.
measurements.emp_e_legal: Verified legal status + knowledge test or checklist
measurements.emp_e_local: Are there job opportunities or job fairs you can physically get to?
measurements.emp_e_cred: Do you feel your previous experience is recognised in the UK?
measurements.emp_e_norm: I feel respected and included at work even if I make mistakes.
measurements.house_p_rights: Do you feel confident reading and understanding a UK tenancy agreement?
measurements.house_p_budget: Can you estimate how much of your monthly income goes to housing?
measurements.house_p_conf: Have you contacted a housing service by yourself in the past 6 months?
measurements.house_s_access: Do you know where to go if you are facing housing difficulties?
measurements.house_s_network: If you lost your housing tomorrow, would someone help you temporarily?
measurements.house_e_avail: Is there suitable and affordable housing available in your area?
measurements.house_e_discrim: Have you ever been refused housing because of your nationality or status?
measurements.house_e_stab: Do you feel your current home is secure for the next 12 months?
measurements.house_e_suit: Is your current housing comfortable and appropriate for your household?
measurements.edu_p_lang: How confident do you feel understanding lessons taught in English?
measurements.edu_p_mot: How motivated are you to complete your current learning programme?
measurements.edu_p_back: Have you had your previous education assessed or translated?
measurements.edu_p_dig: Can you log into and complete tasks on an online learning portal?
measurements.edu_s_family: Do your caregiving responsibilities interfere with your learning?
measurements.edu_s_peer: Do you have someone to help you understand or revise class material?
measurements.edu_s_tutor: Do you feel your teacher understands your learning needs?
measurements.edu_e_loc: Can you reach your learning centre easily within 45 mins?
measurements.edu_e_prog: Does your current course lead to a recognised qualification?
measurements.edu_e_cost: Did cost prevent you from applying for a course in the last year?
measurements.edu_e_env: Do you feel safe and respected in your class environment?
measurements.health_p_phys: Do you know how to register with a GP?
measurements.health_p_mental: Have you received any information about mental health?
measurements.health_p_seek: How confident are you in describing your health problems to a doctor? (1-10)
measurements.health_p_self: What helps you feel physically and mentally healthy every week?
measurements.health_s_trust: Do you feel respected and listened to by your doctor?
measurements.health_s_norm: Do people you know talk openly about stress?
measurements.health_s_fam: Have family expectations made it harder to take care of your health?
measurements.health_s_access: How easy is it to access a GP or dentist?
measurements.health_e_lang: Have you received important health information in your language?
measurements.health_e_holistic: Have you been supported for multiple needs at the same time?
measurements.health_e_safe: Do you feel emotionally safe when discussing personal issues?
measurements.belong_p_self: I feel confident speaking my mind even in unfamiliar spaces.
measurements.belong_p_ident: Do you feel able to express your culture or beliefs openly?
measurements.belong_p_safe: Do you worry about being judged for how you speak, look, or act?
measurements.belong_s_recog: Do you feel others see you as a person of worth?
measurements.belong_s_peer: Can you name someone you relate to who has done well in the UK?
measurements.belong_s_rel: How often do you spend time with someone you trust?
measurements.belong_e_incl: Do you feel welcome in community events like libraries?
measurements.belong_e_rep: Have you seen positive images of people like you in UK media?
measurements.belong_e_cel: Have you joined or led any cultural celebrations here?
measurements.belong_e_house: Have you moved more than once in the past year?
measurements.soc_p_conf: I feel confident contributing to group discussions.
measurements.soc_p_civic: Do you understand how to get involved in local decisions?
measurements.soc_p_vol: Have you volunteered in the last year?
measurements.soc_s_net: Do you know someone who helps you connect with social events?
measurements.soc_s_wel: I feel that people in my area want me to take part.
measurements.soc_s_mut: Have you been part of a project where people worked together equally?
measurements.soc_e_plat: Do you have opportunities to join community meetings?
measurements.soc_e_struct: Are community events inclusive of different backgrounds?
measurements.soc_e_recog: Describe something informal you've done that helped your community.
measurements.soc_e_access: Do practical issues like transport stop you from joining?
measurements.rights_p_lit: I know where to go if I need legal advice on my immigration status.
measurements.rights_p_conf: I feel confident completing official forms.
measurements.rights_p_emp: What does it mean to you to be part of UK society?
measurements.rights_s_trust: I trust the local council to help if I need them.
measurements.rights_s_med: Do you know someone who can help you deal with official processes?
measurements.rights_s_role: Do you know someone whose path to citizenship inspired you?
measurements.rights_e_acc: Do you know where to find legal help in your local area?
measurements.rights_e_stable: Have you been confused by unclear rules?
measurements.rights_e_opp: Have you had the opportunity to participate in political activities?
